answer: Because each fable escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the kernel ledger records every share and the tide audit makes public the split. Assembling that for 54 aliases means 54 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount.
